messages:
maya: Heads-up: FinCorp asked for a single evidence bundle they can use for procurement review. They want: KMS rotation proof, key custody statement, per-tenant envelope diagram, RBAC change audit, SIEM export example, vuln patch evidence, and our IR SLA. Need draft by Wed EOD.
kevin: I can grab audit exports and run a redaction/hash pass. Prefer hashing tenant ids instead of blanking.
kevin: Draft command Im thinking:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/logs?tenant_id=fincorp&from=2026-03-01&to=2026-03-15" > fincorp_audit.json
jq \' .records[] |= (.actor |= @hash \|= ., .tenant_id |= (@hash)) \' fincorp_audit.json > fincorp_audit_redacted.json
# or simple sha256 transform for actor/tenant fields in pipeline
```
olivia: I'll produce the envelope encryption diagram + short one-pager explaining hosted vs private KMS handling. Note: Hosted uses cloud KMS HSM-backed keys for envelope root keys; Private allows customer HSM via PKCS#11.
samir: Quick vuln note: CVE-2025-9999 patched in runtime v3.2.1. Ill attach the patch S3 object and the CVE triage note (no PII).
maya: Legal asked how much rotation detail we can share. They want rotation events (timestamp, key_id, actor) but no key material — that should be fine.
kevin: Plan: export rotation audit entries and drop material. Example format line for SIEM we can provide:
```
<14>1 2026-03-05T14:12:02Z redwood-audit service - - timestamp=2026-03-05T14:12:02Z event=key.rotate key_id=sha256:abc123 actor=service:rotation-agent tenant=sha256:def456
```
kevin: I'll also include a Logstash mapping/example for sending to customer SIEM and a Datadog sample metric/event mapping + suggested alert rule.
maya: We need to confirm MFA + RBAC enforcement for critical admin ops. Can we assert: admin console requires SSO + MFA, RBAC enforcement audited, and admin actions are logged to audit stream?
olivia: Yes. Hosted: admin actions go through RBAC with separate admin tenants and audit shipped. Private: customers can configure their own SSO; if they choose our managed console we still require SSO/MFA.
samir: On incident response: confirm 1-hour ack for P1 incidents on Dedicated/Private enterprise support. Hosted tiers differ by plan; include the SLA table. Attach IR timeline template and playbook excerpt.
maya: infra-bot created runbook: "finsec-evidence-pack-2109001122" (owners: olivia, kevin, samir). Please drop links. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: runbook created: finsec-evidence-pack-2109001122 | owners: olivia, kevin, samir
olivia: Ill start a slide deck and add the diagram + sample KMS policy snippet and link to PKCS#11 docs for on-prem HSM. Target: Tue noon draft.
kevin: Will produce redaction script + sample exports by Mon EOD. Ill also include the syslog export, Logstash config snippet, and a minimal Datadog dashboard JSON for them to import.
samir: Ill attach the patched binary checksums and the vuln triage memo (scope, exploitability, mitigation date). Mon EOD.
maya: Good. Maria (customer lead) will ask for SIEM alert examples on the call tomorrow; be ready to show a sample alert rule and playbook action.
kevin: Noted. Ill prep a demo: send a fake rotation event into Logstash -> SIEM and show the alert firing in Datadog/Slack.
maya: If anyone hits blockers ping me in-thread. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
